annotations.title: Search the tables of an act

description: SEARCH THE ROWS OF AN ACT'S TABLES for the words of a question or for a code. A row matches when EVERY word is in it, in whichever of its cells («ADENURIC 120» finds the row whose name and strength sit in two cells); diacritics and case are ignored. Each match comes with the ids of its cells, the row under the column names, its place in the table, the rows above and below, and the table's title. Use mode 'exact' for a code (4426, 2110, W57781001): the word must be a whole cell, and a trailing * makes it a prefix (442*). It searches ONE act or ONE table (law or table is required), by words: it does not search by meaning. Pictures have no text and are not searched; PRE blocks (diagrams, ASCII tables) are searched where their exact text is kept; the answer says what the act holds that was not read.

columns.description: Look in these columns only: names or numbers, comma separated.

law.description: The act that holds the tables, however it is at hand: a citation ('ORDIN 337/2007', 'OMFP 1802/2014'), a common name ('Codul fiscal') or a title any tool printed.

mode.description: 'lexical' (default): each word is contained in a cell. 'exact': each word is a whole cell (code); a trailing * makes it a prefix.

neighbors.description: Rows shown above and below each match (default 1).

query.description: The words or the code to look for, up to eight words; stopwords are dropped.

rows_per_table.description: Most rows taken from one table (default 3).

table.description: The table, as list_tables or search_tables printed it: 'tabel:14164713.0' (or just 14164713 when the node holds one table).

name: search_tables
